observable_effects: one-wire mode writes 0x6c to register 0x3e, 0x75 to 0x3c, then sets bit 3 of 0x3a
normal mode derives trigger 1 cached bytes and programs registers 0x39, 0x33, and 0x36
both modes derive trigger 2 and trigger 3 cached state and program registers 0x39, 0x34, 0x37, 0x3a, 0x35, and 0x38 in stock order
all I2C helper return values are ignored
limitations: Register writes are reconstructed from static evidence; no device hardware validation is claimed.
